Break up of allotted seats PG Medical course at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences and the rules of admission/ admission procedure along with code of conduct of the institute are given on our website (
www.mgims.ac.in

The candidates must bring:
All the required original documents along with
two
sets of attested photocopies of their relevant documents.
Soft copy of all the relevant required documents in jpg or pdf format below 500 kb, photo and signature of the candidate file must be below 5 kb.
Sufficient money for fees, security and other deposits.
No extra time shall be given to any candidate under any circumstances if required certificates (eligibility/ category) are not produced at the time of counselling as per format given in annexure in the rules and regulations for admissions in medical PG courses 2017-18 on our website
www.mgims.ac.in
.
The candidates should strictly appear on dates as per programme given in the schedule at their own cost. Counselling will held in the Seminar Hall, Kasturba Nursing College, MGIMS Campus, Sevagram, Dist- Wardha at 8.30 AM and onwards, with all the required original documents as per information booklet. Based on the verification of certificates and NEET marks (Score) admissions to PG Medical courses at MGIMS, Sevagram will be decided accordingly. The selected candidates have to undergo the medical examination and if found medically fit they will be provisionally admitted on the deposition of required fee and can join their respective departments immediately/ latest by 2
nd
may 2017 after counselling.

paragraphs: Process for PG Medical courses academic session 2017-18 will be as follows

Break up of allotted seats PG Medical course at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences and the rules of admission/ admission procedure along with code of conduct of the institute are given on our website (www.mgims.ac.in)

No extra time shall be given to any candidate under any circumstances if required certificates (eligibility/ category) are not produced at the time of counselling as per format given in annexure in the rules and regulations for admissions in medical PG courses 2017-18 on our website www.mgims.ac.in.

The candidates should strictly appear on dates as per programme given in the schedule at their own cost. Counselling will held in the Seminar Hall, Kasturba Nursing College, MGIMS Campus, Sevagram, Dist- Wardha at 8.30 AM and onwards, with all the required original documents as per information booklet. Based on the verification of certificates and NEET marks (Score) admissions to PG Medical courses at MGIMS, Sevagram will be decided accordingly. The selected candidates have to undergo the medical examination and if found medically fit they will be provisionally admitted on the deposition of required fee and can join their respective departments immediately/ latest by 2 nd may 2017 after counselling.
